title: Effect of operation symmetry on data efficiency may be architecture-dependent
description: The paper notes that symmetric operations require less data for generalization than non-symmetric counterparts, but cautions that this effect may be partially dependent on the transformer architecture's ease of learning symmetric functions.
canonical_description: the data efficiency advantage of symmetric operations may depend on model architecture

evidence.quote: We believe this effect might be partially architecture-dependent, since it's easy for a transformer to learn a symmetric function of the operands by ignoring positional embedding.
